comparisons.unit: configuration cell; paired stages; conditional on fixed 32-cell panel
comparisons.bootstrap: Resample whole configuration cells; recompute pooled rates using paired counts. Thresholds remain the declared fitted calibration thresholds. Intervals do not include threshold refitting or independently sampled physical systems.

bound_boundary: Conditional Gaussian simple-versus-simple bounds require false-positive control uniformly at every conditional null mean, including the nearest phase alternative. They do not bound a detector controlling only average-mixture FPR. Exact baseline, scale, noise family and templates are privileged simulated inputs.
historical_boundary: Old exact-RMS noise is not Gaussian. Its old detector gate failures do not prove mathematical nonidentifiability. Stage 0 retains that distribution as a control; no Gaussian bound is applied there.
